theme_width.settle_gate: Every animated concept root must reach at least 0.99 opacity after a 700 ms authored-motion settle before capture.

baseline.calculation: 8 concepts x 8 themes x 4 widths x 2 rail states

feature_states.calculation: 28 feature states x 8 themes x 4 widths
feature_states.host_role: coverage-only; no rank, preference, or winner recommendation

history_artifact.calculation: 8 windows x 4 history modes x 5 artifact states

direct_visual_inspection.method: Direct original-resolution review of every settled canonical PNG; automated matrices remain separate from visual judgment.

chromium_parity_spot_check.coverage: four narrow dark themes, four wide light themes, one dense questionnaire, one work system, one route popup, and one pop-out context state
chromium_parity_spot_check.claim_boundary: Representative parity review only; the full 55-frame direct-inspection claim applies to the canonical Firefox set.

review_findings: All eight diagonal window/thread compositions retain distinct spatial and reading grammars rather than palette-only variation.
The 520 px Chat measure preserves readable prose and visible metadata while artifact and pinned-history regions yield outside the Chat measure.
All eight question grammars and all eight work grammars were directly inspected; dense questionnaire commit controls remain visible above the held composer.
Route, decision, warning, artifact-error, offline, durable-composer, pop-out, and demo-controller states remain legible and spatially recoverable.
No concept is designated or implied as the winner.

known_residuals: The 512 baseline and 896 feature cells are automated state and geometry coverage, not 1,408 individual human image reviews.
Firefox completed over loopback HTTP; Chromium completed over a file URL because this host's Chromium renderer fails before requesting even a trivial loopback page. Chromium-over-HTTP is not claimed.
Native Slint rendering, detached-window DPI, platform font metrics, IME, assistive-technology validation, and live services remain production work.
